experiment: E15 Fault and Late-Client Robustness Suite

scenarios.name: Normal On-Time Submissions
scenarios.description: 3 clients submit valid updates within window Tr

scenarios.name: Late Client Rejection
scenarios.description: Client submits update after round expiry timestamp Tr

scenarios.name: Replay / Duplicate Protection
scenarios.description: Replay of consumed UID_r within or across rounds

scenarios.name: Key Context Mismatch Rejection
scenarios.description: Submission from stale or different round key context

scenarios.name: Tampered AAD Authentication Failure
scenarios.description: Ciphertext encrypted under mismatched AAD binding fails AES-GCM decryption tag

scenarios.name: Partial Client Dropout Graceful Aggregation
scenarios.description: 1 client crashes/drops; remaining 2 clients successfully aggregate

scenarios.name: Total Dropout Round Handling
scenarios.description: Zero client updates received; round terminates cleanly without corrupting global model

scenarios.name: Post-Round Decryption Key Destruction
scenarios.description: Round key zeroed in memory; retrospective recovery impossible

scenarios.name: Subsequent Round Recovery
scenarios.description: System issues fresh certificate and key context; normal federated learning resumes seamlessly
